{{Quote|Datafile on System VV-99-7JE-2N71: Dangerous ion discharge activity present. Sun: spectral classification orange-yellow; see reference note later in file.|Report by Bshrah-Ky-Ushsj|<ref name="Journal7" />}}
'''System VV-99-7JE-2N71''' was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Shiwal sector/Legends|Shiwal sector]]. It contained an unstable [[Color/Legends|orange]]-yellow [[Star/Legends|star]] and sixteen [[Planet/Legends|planets]], nine of which were [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] along with one non-[[Gas/Legends|gaseous]] world that sustained an ecosystem with various [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was surveyed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Bshrah-Ky-Ushsj]], who noted in a report that the system's sun was prone to [[Solar flare/Legends|flaring]] and that it could potentially explode as a [[Nova/Legends|nova]].

At some point, the ''[[Kragg's Fury]]'', the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hez Kragg]], ended up abandoned in the system. The [[Treasure hunting/Legends|fortune hunter]] [[Sig Coven]] discovered the drifting ''Kragg's Fury'' during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Coven informed the [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] [[Jonas Durns]] about his find, and Durns in turn arranged for an [[Expedition to System VV-99-7JE-2N71|expedition]] to System VV-99-7JE-2N71 to confirm the starship's identity. Durns recruited a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] for transportation to the system, and the expedition ultimately boarded the ancient vessel and subsequently left it with a valuable chest. The ''Kragg's Fury'', however, self-destructed by flying into the system's star.

==Description==
{{Quote|Nine planets are gaseous; seven are solid matter. Five of the solid worlds have atmospheres. Planet Four has breathable atmosphere; variety of lifeforms present, none are predatory to sapients.|Report by Bshrah-Ky-Ushsj|<ref name="Journal7" />}}
System VV-99-7JE-2N71 was located in the [[Shiwal sector/Legends|Shiwal sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system's]] weak, [[Color/Legends|orange]]-yellow [[Star/Legends|star]] was unstable and prone to highly intensive [[Solar flare/Legends|flaring]] and [[Gas/Legends|outgassing]]. The resulting activity of ion discharges in the system presented a hazard to visitors.<ref name="Journal7" />

The system's sun was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by sixteen prominent [[Planet/Legends|planets]], one of which was covered in yellow-orange [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]]. Nine of the orbital bodies were [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type worlds, and the rest of the planets were made up of solid matter. Five of the non-gaseous worlds had [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]], with the air of the fourth planet being breathable. The fourth planet was inhabited by various [[Species/Legends|species]], but there were no [[Diet/Legends|predators]] there that preyed on [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings.<ref name="Journal7" />

==History==
===Visitors to the system===
{{Quote|Alert: Detailed analysis of solar componentry has shown massive flaring and outgassing with potential for nova explosion. Standard warning beacons have been placed along outer system perimeter.|Report by Bshrah-Ky-Ushsj|<ref name="Journal7" />}}
At some point, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Bshrah-Ky-Ushsj]] performed a survey of System VV-99-7JE-2N71. The scout briefly described the main planets of the system in a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] report, although at least one of the worlds was left unnamed and the scout was unable to perform a proper examination of the one planet in the system that had a breathable atmosphere and living organisms on it. In addition, Bshrah-Ky-Ushsj carried out a detailed analysis of the stellar components of the system's sun and determined that the star could at one point explode as a [[Nova/Legends|nova]]. To warn potential future arrivals, the scout placed standard [[warning beacon]]s along the perimeter of the outer system.<ref name="Journal7" />

[[File:KraggsFury-Journal7.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Kragg's Fury'' was adrift in System VV-99-7JE-2N71.]]
The ''[[Kragg's Fury]]'', the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the legendary [[Dread Buccaneer]] [[Hez Kragg]], eventually ended up abandoned in System VV-99-7JE-2N71. A [[Skeleton/Legends|skeleton]] was seated in the command chair of the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], with two chests&mdash;one empty but adorned with a valuable seal of Kragg and the other filled with jewels and other valuables&mdash;lying at its [[Limb/Legends|feet]]. An ancient [[Gladiator droid/Legends|gladiator droid]] was [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] to react to an attempt to take a chest and plot a course for the starship to plunge into the system's sun. According to a later [[Youngling/Legends|child's]] fable, a powerful [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] defeated Kragg aboard his ship but was forced to leave the vessel adrift due to being grievously wounded during the fight.<ref name="Journal7" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Treasure hunting/Legends|fortune hunter]] and scout [[Sig Coven]] accidentally discovered the ''Kragg's Fury''. Taking [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] images of the starship but unable to identify it at the [[Time/Legends|time]], Coven recorded the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates of System VV-99-7JE-2N71 on a direct-read-only [[astrogation datacard]] and eventually contacted the [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] and [[University/Legends|university]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] [[Jonas Durns]]. Durns, who had been trying to prove the historicity of Kragg for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], believed that treasure looted during the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate's]] raid on the [[Nijune Treasure Fleet]] was still aboard his starship. The researcher was then able to secure funding from his university for an [[Expedition to System VV-99-7JE-2N71|expedition]] to determine whether the ship Coven had found was indeed the ''Kragg's Fury''.<ref name="Journal7" />

===The expedition===
{{RPG|"[[Silent Fury]]"}}
{{Quote|You can't be too careful in my business.|Sig Coven, upon being questioned about the secure astrogation datacard|<ref name="Journal7" />}}
Durns hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to transport himself, his daughter [[Keya Durns|Keya]], and Coven to System VV-99-7JE-2N71. While in transit, one of the spacers [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] Coven's [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]]. Learning of the Republic survey report of the system, the spacers confronted Coven about the hazardous nature of their destination. However, Coven dismissed their concerns and believed the risk to be one worth taking.<ref name="Journal7" />

Arriving in System VV-99-7JE-2N71, the spacers' ship approached the ''Kragg's Fury'', noticing the personal emblem of Kragg painted on the vessel's [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. Docking with the pirate starship, the expedition navigated the ship's interior, avoiding traps and ancient [[Bodyguard droid/Legends|defense droids]] on its way to the bridge. After determining the password needed to enter the bridge, the spacers retrieved one of the chests located there, which led to the gladiator [[Droid/Legends|droid]] sending the ship on a course into the system's sun. The expedition members managed to escape the ''Kragg's Fury'' aboard their starship and observed the disintegration of the pirate vessel in a series of explosions at the star. The spacers' ship subsequently left System VV-99-7JE-2N71 with the pirate chest aboard.<ref name="Journal7" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
System VV-99-7JE-2N71 appeared in "[[Silent Fury]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure outline authored by [[Tony Russo]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published within the article "[[A Taste of Adventure]]" as part of the [[August]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 7|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 7]]. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Journal7" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square L-7.<ref name="TEA" />
